description: Import a supported local model into an empty or base scene, apply requested composition options, and save a new scene.

adjustCameraLookAt.description: Ask KeyShot to retarget the active camera to the imported geometry when supported.

adjustEnvironment.description: Ask KeyShot to adjust the environment to the imported geometry when supported.

baseScenePath.description: Optional existing KeyShot scene to use as the import base. Omit to start from an empty scene.

centerGeometry.description: Ask KeyShot to center imported geometry during import when supported.

modelPath.description: Absolute path to a model file supported by KeyShot, such as OBJ, FBX, STL, or glTF.

outputScenePath.description: Destination path for the saved KeyShot scene. The path must stay inside KEYSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR unless external outputs are explicitly enabled.

snapToGround.description: Ask KeyShot to place imported geometry on the ground plane when supported.

name: keyshot_import_model

data.description: Operation-specific structured result data, or null when unavailable.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason, or null after success.

errorCode.description: Stable error category for common failures.

keyshotStdoutTail.description: Truncated tail of KeyShot headless output for diagnostics.

ok.description: True when the requested operation completed successfully.

outputFiles.description: Absolute paths of images or scene files created by the operation.

suggestions.description: Actionable recovery steps for the user or agent.

warnings.description: Non-fatal conditions the user or agent should review.

title: Import a model into KeyShot
